observations.finding: 22/50 pathways significant; strongest up-regulation of PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS (SMD 1.25, q=5e-05), with down-regulation of ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION (SMD -0.90, q=0.000275), IL6_JAK_STAT3 (SMD -0.85, q=0.000517), and INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE (SMD -0.71, q=0.0015).

evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: Suggests an immune-quiescent, VHL/PBRM1-associated ccRCC subset with reduced 14q loss and CDKN2A deletion; coherent but mutation evidence is weak.

observations.finding: 7/50 pathways significant; strong up-regulation of INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE (SMD 1.30, q=0.0001), INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE (SMD 1.22, q=0.00015), ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION (SMD 1.07, q=0.000467), IL6_JAK_STAT3 (SMD 1.03, q=0.0008), and COMPLEMENT (SMD 0.91, q=0.00185).
BAP1 strongly enriched (50% vs 3.6%, OR 26.7, 95% CI 6.27-113.5, q=3.6e-05) and PBRM1 strongly depleted (5% vs 45.8%, OR 0.062, q=0.0062).
No continuous or gain/loss feature significant after adjustment (min q=0.082); PTEN/chr10q higher in set as nonsignificant trends.

Retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate.
